# Handoff Analysis

## Status Summary

| Metric | Champion | Last PASS Candidate | Delta |
|--------|----------|---------------------|-------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 | -7.5% |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 | -88% ⚠️ |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | **1.793** | ≈0 |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** | +19% |
| Worst MDD | **-9.3%** | -11.2% | worse |

## Assessment

**Champion retained** — The candidate showed improved lockbox minimum (more consistent OOS), but critical weaknesses prevented promotion:

1. **Robustness concern**: Tuning min of 0.05 indicates near-zero performance on at least one fold
2. **Drawdown degradation**: Worst MDD widened from -9.3% to -11.2%
3. **Lower tuning mean**: 7.5% reduction suggests overfit to specific conditions

## Runloop Health
```
✓ 22 loops completed
✓ 2h 16m elapsed / ~46h remaining  
✓ No INCONCLUSIVE stuck candidates
✓ Champion stable
```

## Recommended Actions

Execute the provided commands in sequence:

```bash
# 1. Continue AUB exploration
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best

# 2. Run system-level candidates  
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run

# 3. Generate fix report
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

**Priority focus**: The tuning min fragility suggests exploring regularization or ensemble approaches to improve worst-fold stability while maintaining lockbox performance.
